text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 8, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "8 more apples than Jamal"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half as many bananas as Jamal"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 4, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "4 more bananas than apples"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 52, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "Andrea has 52 apples"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q4", "q1"], "out": "s1", "note": "Jamal's apples, since Andrea has 8 more apples than Jamal"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "q3"], "out": "s2", "note": "Jamal's bananas, 4 more than Jamal's apples"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s2", "q2"], "out": "s3", "note": "Andrea's bananas, half as many as Jamal's bananas"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q4", "s1"], "out": "s4", "note": "Andrea's apples plus Jamal's apples"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s4", "s2"], "out": "s5", "note": "add Jamal's bananas"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s5", "s3"], "out": "s6", "note": "add Andrea's bananas to get the total number of fruits"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the total number of fruits (apples and bananas) Andrea and Jamal have"}, "dismissed": []}
